title: A threat model table
description:
List what could go wrong with a feature, using STRIDE, and what you will do about each.

```
feature: mod loading
Spoofing      a mod pretends to be another          -> ids checked against the folder name
Tampering     a mod changes another mod's files     -> mods read-only after loading
Elevation     a mod runs code outside its sandbox   -> data mods only, plugins reviewed
...
2 risks without a plan -> listed at the end
```
hints: Go through all six categories in order, even when you think one does not apply: that is the point of the method (lesson 17.05).
requirements: A list of `(category, threat, mitigation)` rows; the categories are Spoofing, Tampering, Repudiation, Information disclosure, Denial of service, Elevation of privilege.
Print a table and the rows with an empty mitigation.
Warn when a category has no rows at all.
stretch: Keep the model next to the code and update it with each feature.
